headline: Bases-loaded walk in 14th lifts Phillies past Braves
recap: The Phillies beat the Atlanta Braves 3-2 in 14 innings at Veterans Stadium, winning it when pinch-hitter Davey Johnson drew a bases-loaded walk off Steve Hargan in the bottom of the 14th, forcing in Greg Luzinski with the deciding run.

Larry Christenson worked all nine innings for Philadelphia, allowing both Atlanta runs on a two-run home run by Jeff Burroughs in the top of the eighth. Braves starter Buzz Capra went seven innings and gave up a two-run homer to Luzinski in the bottom of the third, which had been the Phillies' only runs to that point.

Both bullpens held the game scoreless into the 14th. Ron Reed and Tug McGraw each threw a scoreless inning for Philadelphia before Gene Garber worked the 13th and 14th to pick up the win. Hargan, on in relief since the 12th, loaded the bases on a walk, an intentional walk and another walk before forcing in the winning run.
